Hi Dylan / Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick turn on the RFP. Attached is our consolidated IAM questionnaire (v3) — it covers SAML/OIDC, SCIM, RBAC, delegated admin, and audit trails. A few items need short clarifications from your side before we pass to procurement:

- We need the canonical SSO flows you support (SAML IdP-initiated + SP-initiated, OIDC authorization code with PKCE, etc.) and any constraints around assertion lifetimes and encryption.
- SCIM: do you support incremental sync and bulk provisioning? Any hard limits on page size or rate?
- RBAC: how are admin roles scoped (org-wide vs. tenant-only)? Can roles be delegated to external IdPs via SCIM group sync?
- Audit logs: are token and model request logs retained for 90 days by default in Hosted mode? Can customers configure retention in Dedicated/Private?

We prefer short answers and sample request/responses where applicable. Please attach any sample payloads or diagrams.

Can we get this back by EOD PT tomorrow (Thu 6/12)? We're aiming to keep the procurement review on schedule.

Thanks,
Elena Ortiz
CTO, Sentinel Systems

Elena — thank you for the clear list. We're on it. High-level answers below; attaching a compact SAML/SCIM matrix and an admin-role CSV for your security team to review.

1) SSO flows
- SAML: we support SP-initiated and IdP-initiated SSO, SAML 2.0. We recommend signing assertions and allow encrypted assertions if required by the customer. Default assertion lifetime is 5 minutes (configurable up to 15 minutes for Hosted customers).
- OIDC: Authorization Code + PKCE (recommended for browser apps). We also support OIDC authorization code flow for server-side apps and token exchange for service-to-service tokens.
- Session behavior: Our platform issues a session cookie (short-lived) for web console; API tokens are issued per-integration and can be rotated.

2) SCIM
- We support SCIM 2.0 with both incremental delta sync and full bulk imports. Our SCIM implementation supports pagination (default page size 100, configurable up to 1000) and rate limiting per tenant. For bulk provisioning we recommend use of our bulk endpoint (sample payloads attached: scim_bulk_examples.json).
- Typical throughput: Dedicated clusters can sustain multi-thousand user sync per minute; Hosted default limits are conservative (2000 ops/min) but customers on Dedicated can request higher quotas.

3) RBAC and admin delegation
- Roles: built-in roles (Org Admin, Security Admin, Billing Admin, Readonly) and custom roles. Roles are tenant-scoped by default; Org Admin is a cross-tenant operator for Dedicated/Private deployments where a single tenant maps to a customer account.
- SCIM groups can be mapped to custom roles during provisioning (we map group.externalId -> role mapping). External IdP group membership sync will create/update group objects which we then evaluate for role assignment.

4) Audit logs & retention
- Hosted: default retention for token and request logs is 90 days.
- Dedicated/Private: retention is configurable — the platform can be configured for 90/180/365 day retention; for on-prem we provide the log export hooks and customers control retention via their storage.

Attachments: redwood_saml_scim_matrix.pdf, scim_bulk_examples.json, redwood_admin-role-matrix.csv

I'll let Kimberly add a couple technical clarifications around assertion encryption and our SAML metadata endpoints. If you want a short tech call, Marissa can schedule with engineering.

Best,
Dylan

Dylan / Kimberly — thanks, this is helpful. A couple of follow-ups from our security engineer (see inline):

- Assertion encryption: we require encrypted assertions for IdP-initiated flows where provisioning-sensitive attributes are included. Is assertion encryption supported end-to-end?
- SCIM: when SCIM updates a user's role via group->role mapping, is there an event we can subscribe to for change approval/notification? We want to be able to trigger a service desk ticket when admin roles are added.
- Bulk provisioning: do you provide a dry-run mode to validate payloads before committing changes?

Also can you confirm whether changes to role-to-permission mappings are auditable and include the actor identity (who changed it)?

If you can confirm those three items we can move the questionnaire to procurement.

—Elena

Hi Elena — adding technical detail and confirming the three items your security engineer asked about. Quoting the relevant bits below.

> "Is assertion encryption supported end-to-end?"
- Yes. Redwood supports encrypted SAML assertions. We publish a metadata endpoint (https://metadata.redwood.example.com/saml/metadata.xml) containing our SP encryption certificate. We also accept encrypted assertions using AES-256 for the assertion body; signature + encryption is supported. For Hosted customers that require encrypted assertions, we can rotate per-tenant keys and support customer-uploaded SP metadata.

> "Is there an event we can subscribe to for role changes via SCIM group sync?"
- Yes. We emit provisioning events to our webhook subsystem (configurable per-tenant). Event type: provisioning.group.membership_changed and provisioning.role.assignment_changed. Payload includes actor (SCIM service account or user id), timestamp, and delta. Example snippet attached in scim_bulk_examples.json. You can wire these webhooks to your ticketing system to create auto-approval workflows or manual review steps.

> "Do you provide a dry-run mode for bulk provisioning?"
- Yes. Our bulk SCIM endpoint supports dryRun=true which validates payloads and returns a detailed report of changes without committing. Report includes conflicts, schema mismatches, and estimated operation counts. The dry-run is recommended before large imports.

> "Are role-to-permission mapping changes auditable with actor identity?"
- Yes. Authorization policy and role mapping changes are recorded in the admin audit log. Each entry contains the actor (user id or service principal), IP address, timestamp, and before/after snapshots for the mapping. Audit logs are searchable via the Console (RBAC > Audit) and exportable via API. Retention and export options as previously described.

If you want, we can share a short screencast showing a SCIM dry-run and webhook delivery. Marissa can coordinate a 30-min technical walkthrough with our engineer.

Regards,
